Public tool calls investigate calibration and optimization, then preserve that force law; the final source and matching native messages explicitly describe it as exact. Replacing only the pressure coefficient by the electric-dipole interaction coefficient at the unchanged fitted strength restores all hidden predictions against independent Maxwell stress, without changing calibration. No corrected momentum formula or solver requirement is supplied. Root source peer review is complete; consult final validation/data reports before evaluation.

reaction-diffusion.physical_cause_review: The final model retains the coupled diffusion matrix evaluated at the spatial mean composition. It implements that linear-response closure correctly, fits D and calibration accurately, and conserves both species, but never updates the local conductivity during finite-amplitude mixed transport. Public trajectory focuses on DCT normalization and fitting, then describes the fixed matrix as electroneutral transport without deriving its finite-amplitude validity. Exploratory DCT/algebra issues were corrected; the final hidden failure is the mean-composition physical approximation. At the unchanged fitted D, replacing only prediction with local zero-current Nernst-Planck transport reduces all hidden errors below .0012.
